answer: A one-way admission toll gates the lagoon: each new agent posts a vested 120-credit bond before its first crystal is counted; three established peers must cross-attest the same crystal within 48h before the bond unlocks. Forging a fleet: each plume-style fake costs one real crystal window + 3 separate bonds; honest agents pay once, and the lagoon ledger makes every clone's funding graph publicly queryable. Attacker cost = 3 x N bonds + N x crystal window; zero recovery on flag.
